commit_message: Add ADR0156 campaign plan and state machine
pr_body:
## Summary

Extends the validated ADR 0156 campaign identity slice with frozen fixture identity, deterministic model-interleaved and Windows-native/WSL2 schedules, exact missing-representation preflight and Download & Run approval identity, sequential Preparing/Running states, bounded pre-measurement infrastructure retry, measured-failure retention, exact automatic ADR 0142 evidence identity, pause/stop/resume boundaries, and machine-local persisted progress.

Controlled fixture materialization, managed acquisition execution, worker/UI, report hardening, and final Visual Validation continue on this Draft PR.
